name: thesparkle-mobile
description: Isolated Capacitor Android and iOS shell for TheSparkle

scripts.android:debug: npm run sync:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: npm run sync:web && cap sync ios && cap open ios
